# Best Password Manager for Business, Enterprise & Personal | Bitwarden

Bitwarden is the most trusted password manager for passwords and passkeys at home or at work, on any browser or device. Start with a free trial.

## Documentation Resources
- For comprehensive help documentation, see: https://bitwarden.com/help/llms-full.txt
- For comprehensive blog content, see https://bitwarden.com/blog/llms-full.txt
- For comprehensive resource content, see https://bitwarden.com/resources/llms-full.txt

## Personal Use
- [Personal](https://bitwarden.com/products/personal.md): Explore Bitwarden features tailored for individual users and families, including generating and managing secure passwords.

## Business Solutions
- [Business](https://bitwarden.com/products/business.md): Discover Bitwarden offerings for businesses, focusing on password management and security.
- [Enterprise Services](https://bitwarden.com/enterprise-password-manager.md): Learn about advanced services and features available for enterprise-level clients.
- [Enterprise Policies](https://bitwarden.com/help/policies.md): Understand the policies that govern enterprise accounts and user management.
- [SSO Integration](https://bitwarden.com/integrations/#sso-integrations): Information on integrating Single Sign-On for seamless access using existing identity providers.
- [Directory Integration](https://bitwarden.com/integrations/#directory-integrations): Details on how to integrate with existing directory services for user management.
- [Role Based Access Control (RBAC)](https://bitwarden.com/help/user-types-access-control.md): Explanation of how to manage users’ roles and permissions for shared access.

## Security Features
- [Emergency Access](https://bitwarden.com/help/emergency-access.md): Features that allow trusted contacts to access your vault in case of emergencies.
- [Sensitive Data Sharing](https://bitwarden.com/help/about-send.md): Securely share sensitive information with team members or external partners.
- [Auditable Event Logs](https://bitwarden.com/help/event-logs.md): Monitor and audit user activity for compliance and security purposes.
- [Security Compliance](https://bitwarden.com/compliance.md): Information on how Bitwarden meets numerous security compliance standards.
- [Account Recovery](https://bitwarden.com/help/account-recovery.md): Allows designated administrators to recover enterprise organization user accounts.
- [Open Source](https://bitwarden.com/open-source.md): Explanation of why Bitwarden uses a trusted open source architecture, where the code lives, and who reviews it.
- [Bug Bounty Program](https://bitwarden.com/help/is-bitwarden-audited/#bug-bounty-program): Bitwarden interacts with independent security researchers through public and private bug bounty programs on HackerOne.
- [Open Source Security Summit](https://bitwarden.com/open-source-security-summit.md): Yearly conference featuring leaders in the cybersecurity industry.
- [Bitwarden Security Whitepaper](https://bitwarden.com/help/bitwarden-security-white-paper.md): Whitepaper detailing Bitwarden security principles, features, compliance, data sharing, and more. 

## Password Management Tools
- [Password Generator](https://bitwarden.com/password-generator/): A tool to create strong, unique passwords for your accounts.
- [Password Strength Tester](https://bitwarden.com/password-strength/): Evaluate the strength of your passwords to enhance security.
- [Passphrase Generator](https://bitwarden.com/passphrase-generator/): Generate secure passphrases to protect your accounts.
- [Username Generator](https://bitwarden.com/username-generator/): Create unique usernames to enhance your online security.
- [Autofill Logins](https://bitwarden.com/help/auto-fill-browser.md): Quickly and automatically fill in passwords saved in your vault.
- [Import Passwords from Other Tools](https://bitwarden.com/help/import-data.md): Guides for bringing saved passwords from browsers and other password managers.

## Authentication Options
- [Bitwarden Authenticator](https://bitwarden.com/products/authenticator.md): A standalone app that generates and stores all your two-step verification tokens.
- [Integrated TOTP](https://bitwarden.com/help/integrated-authenticator.md): Time-based One-Time Password integration for enhanced security.
- [Passkeys and Passwordless](https://bitwarden.com/passwordless-passkeys.md): Explore passwordless authentication options for a more secure login experience.

## Developer Resources
- [Secrets Manager](https://bitwarden.com/products/secrets-manager.md): An end-to-end encrypted tool to secure infrastructure and machine secrets.
- [Developer Documentation](https://bitwarden.com/developers.md): Comprehensive documentation for developers integrating Bitwarden into their applications.
- [Integrations](https://bitwarden.com/integrations.md): Overview of third-party integrations available with Bitwarden.
- [Self-Hosting Bitwarden](https://bitwarden.com/self-hosted-password-manager-on-premises.md): Instructions for hosting your own instance of Bitwarden.
